name: ringcentral
description: Work with RingCentral phone and Team Chat: review calls, voicemail, SMS, and faxes; find colleagues; and manage messages, tasks, notes, events, teams, webhooks, and Adaptive Cards.

interface.longDescription: Use RingCentral phone and Team Chat from a compatible AI client. Review calls, voicemail, SMS, and faxes; look up colleagues; read or send messages; and manage Team Chat tasks, notes, events, teams, webhooks, and Adaptive Cards. Access is limited to data and actions permitted by the connected RingCentral account.
capabilities: Send SMS and Team Chat messages
defaultPrompt: Show my recent voicemails and summarize what needs attention.
Draft a follow-up email for my latest customer call.
Catch me up on unread Team Chat messages and open tasks.
